answer: Every claim climbs the walnut of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the glacier re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The umber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
